h: Hidden and Revealed Sevens: Rachel's Sons, Moshe and the Well

p: — In the holy Zohar on this parashah
— the Jubilee is hidden and not revealed,
— Come and see: at the time
— and the holy Zohar elaborates there.

paragraphs.text: Zohar I 153b (Vayetzei): continued in the next paragraph. R. Elazar: “R. Elazar said: Come and see: everywhere the Jubilee is hidden and not revealed, while the Shemitah is revealed. Come and see: at the time that Yaakov worked the first seven years, a voice went forth and said, ‘Yaakov, from world to world’” — the Jubilee is always concealed and the Shemitah revealed; when Yaakov served his first seven years a voice proclaimed "from world to world" (Tehillim 106:48), the hidden upper world of the Jubilee. Both quoted Zohar paragraphs stand on 153b.

paragraphs.text: Zohar I 153b (Vayetzei): “Rachel bore two tzaddikim ... and therefore Yosef and Binyamin are two tzaddikim. Yosef merited to be the tzaddik above, because he guarded the sign of the covenant. Binyamin is the tzaddik below, so that the Shemitah be crowned between two tzaddikim” — Rachel bore two tzaddikim; Yosef merited to be the tzaddik above because he guarded the covenant, Binyamin is the tzaddik below, so that the Shemitah is crowned between two tzaddikim. The paragraph just before (Zohar I 153b) says “Leah bore six sons and one daughter ... six sides,” the source of Rav Tzadok’s preceding statement that Leah bore six sons and a daughter.

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Maharal, Gur Aryeh, Bereishis 30:25: “‘Once his adversary was born,’ etc. It seems this is because Yaakov and Esav are opposites in every matter, as Scripture shows, and Yosef is the essence of Yaakov’s offspring, as it is written, ‘These are the generations of Yaakov: Yosef.’ Therefore Scripture likens Yaakov to fire and the house of Yosef to a flame (Ovadiah 1:18), for Yosef came forth from Yaakov as the flame comes forth from the fire. The meaning is that Esav stands against Yaakov, but since Yaakov is only a part, Yaakov and Esav having been born from one womb, the power of Yaakov does not prevail over Esav. But when the power of Yaakov goes forth into actuality, namely the sons, and especially Yosef, who is called his son, then it exists in actuality and in completeness. Whatever is only in potential does not prevail; but once the potential has gone forth into actuality through his seed, which has no bond with the seed of Esav, then ‘the house of Yosef is a flame.’ Nevertheless it still needs the fire, which is the basis of the flame, for Yaakov is the root and the bearer of all this.”

paragraphs.text: Connection: The Maharal explains the tradition Rav Tzadok cites here: Esav falls before Yaakov's power only once that power is made actual in Rachel's son, while Yaakov remains its root. This is the same division Rav Tzadok makes between Yaakov, the root of Knesset Yisrael, and Yosef, who clarifies it.

p: — And this is what is said:
— for the beginning of the conquest
— who was commanded to carry out
— and it was not completed then.
— came the essential eradication of Amalek;
— that is, to eliminate the evil.
— the victory over the idolatrous nations
— to eliminate the evil from Israel.
— for Yaakov did not know of them,
— because they were of the Jubilee;
— the endeavor of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
— to clarify in the hidden realms
— that Israel are bound at the root
— so that “our will is to do Your will.”
— the seven years that are revealed
— that in deed and action too,
— who “all his days did not sin,”
— as written in the holy Zohar.
— In truth, there was no need
— for Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
— to work more than seven years;
— for once he had been clarified

paragraphs.text: Parallel: R. Shmuel Bornsztain of Sochatchov, Shem MiShmuel, Vayishlach 2:4: “It will be understood by first explaining the matter of the two Mashiachs that Israel will have, speedily in our days, Mashiach ben Yosef and Mashiach ben David. Through Mashiach ben Yosef the seed of Amalek will be wiped out and the war with the seed of Esav will be fought, for Esav falls only by the hand of the sons of Rachel. And as in the outward, so in the spiritual: he will remove the dividing screen before the heart of Israel, tear open the closure of their heart and soften the heart of stone, until afterward Mashiach ben David comes and finds a heart of flesh prepared and fit to receive the light, ‘that it is good,’ drawn from above. It seems that the evil will be eliminated through Mashiach ben Yosef; but after the removal of the leaven, Mashiach ben David will draw down very great lights, illuminate the eyes of Israel and plant in their hearts an exceeding love to cleave to the Name of Hashem. Accordingly, the work of Mashiach ben Yosef will be like plowing that loosens the earth to receive the sowing done by Mashiach ben David.”

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Pri Tzaddik, Korach 6:2: “Moshe and Aharon are equal to one another. And as we find (Bava Batra 75a), ‘the face of Moshe was like the face of the sun’; that is, like Yaakov our father, who is called the sun, as it says, ‘and behold, the sun,’ and in the Midrash (Bereishit Rabbah, beginning of Vayetzei), ‘for the sun had set: the sun has come, etc.’ That is, he was like Adam HaRishon before the sin, who knew nothing of evil at all, and of whom it is written, ‘and they were not ashamed.’ This is what is said in the Gemara (Bava Metzia 84a), that the beauty of Yaakov resembled the beauty of Adam HaRishon, and in the holy Zohar (I 168a), the very beauty of Adam HaRishon. And likewise Moshe Rabbeinu: when he was born the house was filled with light. But Moshe Rabbeinu did not know of this at all and did not hold it to be his own merit, only that Hashem had chosen him. Through this Moshe and Aharon merited that Moshe be the groomsman of the King, to bring down the words of Torah, and Aharon the groomsman of the Matronita, to make the words of Torah shine in the heart of Israel.”
